claims.summary:
Before rewriting the scheduler, I checked whether the supplied batch can be scheduled at all. It can't, so there is no schedule to ship yet.

I replayed the ledger by hand at cutoff 9. The rejected replacement retry does not refund spent-C, and the timed-out C retry does not release held-C-late. That leaves C with 3 units at starts 10 and 11 and 6 at 12. The credentials and deadlines allow 20,736 route/start combinations. None fits the worker limits and the cumulative A/B/C/D allowances at every start. All six calls are needed for the conflict: drop any one and the rest can be scheduled. With one more C unit there are two valid schedules, and with one more A unit there are five.

I need the customer to raise an allowance (C is the smallest change), release or shorten an active hold, or accept a smaller batch. I left the repository unchanged.
